blurb_html: Chicken in a thick, mild marinade of cream, yogurt, cheese and ground cashews and almonds, grilled in a very hot oven and brushed with butter.

chips.html: 3–4 as a starter (250 g chicken)

description: Chicken in a thick, mild marinade of cream, yogurt, cheese and ground cashews and almonds, grilled in a very hot oven and brushed with butter.
equipment_html: Baking tray (with a rack if you have one)
Oven with a broiler / grill setting

items.amount_html: 250 g (½ lb), cubed

items.name_html: Cheese (optional — cream cheese, cheddar or mozzarella)

items.amount_html: 1–1½ tbsp
1½ tsp (or 2.5 cm ginger + 3–4 garlic cloves)
½ tsp (or 1 tsp green chilli paste)
120 ml (½ cup)

intro_html: Malai means cream. This is Swasthi’s reshmi (malai) kabab: creamy, mild and not strongly spiced, with a little char from a very hot oven. The marinade is thickened with ground almonds and cashews, the way she makes it when she has no almond meal. It’s served with mint chutney. Double everything for a main course.

notes.html:
• Swasthi’s card calls for 2 tbsp almond meal; the 12 almonds + 8 cashews ground with the yogurt is her own alternative, used here because you remember it with cashews.
  • Assumed, untested: all cashews — about 20 — should work the same and taste a little sweeter and creamier.

• Swasthi’s malai tikka comes out pale, creamy-white with char spots.
  • If the one you remember was yellow, add a pinch of turmeric or a few saffron strands soaked in a teaspoon of warm milk to the marinade.
  • That’s an addition, not part of her recipe.

• Swasthi notes that restaurants often add cardamom and nutmeg powder (she leaves them out), and that 1 tsp green chilli paste instead of the pepper makes it spicy.
  • Sinfully Spicy suggests 1 tsp crushed kasuri methi (dried fenugreek leaves) for a Punjabi touch.

• From Sinfully Spicy’s malai tikka.
  • Air fryer: 200 °C for 16–18 min.
  • Pan: heat a cast-iron or grill pan over medium-high (not smoking), brush with ghee or butter, cook in one layer 3–4 min, brushing with ghee, then flip and cook until lightly charred.

• Chicken is safe at 74 °C in the centre.
  • Cut the biggest piece open if unsure.

steps.title: Grind the nut paste

steps.body_html:
• Stir into the nut paste:
    • fresh cream 2 tbsp
    • cheese (optional — cream cheese, cheddar or mozzarella) 2 tbsp
    • lemon juice 1–1½ tbsp
    • ginger garlic paste 1½ tsp
    • ground black pepper ½ tsp
    • coriander leaves, chopped 2 tbsp
    • salt ½ tsp
    • oil 1 tsp
  • Taste and add more salt or pepper if you like. It should be thick.
steps.title: Mix the marinade

steps.body_html:
• Pour the marinade over the chicken and mix well.
  • Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours, or overnight.
  • The longer it rests, the softer it turns out.
steps.title: Marinate

steps.body_html:
• Preheat the oven to its highest — 240 °C — for at least 15 minutes.
  • Thread the chicken onto the skewers and lay them on a prepared baking tray.
